sdk_sessions.user_prompt: In C:\Users\user\Desktop\ERP: `npx prisma migrate diff --from-url <DATABASE_URL from .env.local> --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script` shows major drift between the Neon DB and prisma/schema.prisma. The DB contains tables not in the schema (downtime_response, entry_photo, login_attempt, sales_notifications, fg_dispatch_invoice, fg_sales_approved_batch, fg_sales_hidden_design, batch_range_edit, plus manual backup tables autofill_date_backup_0026, year_typo_backup_0027, date_fix_backup_0028) and columns not in the schema (e.g. sales_payment_divisions.amount_received, sales_packing_lists.accepted_at, sales_credit_notes.applied_at, sales_shipment_docs.discount_amount, proforma_invoices.payment_terms_data, sales_config.invoice_config_granite, several updatedAt DEFAULT drops). Some of these are read by code via raw SQL (check src/lib/downtimeResponse.ts, src/lib/entryPhoto.ts). This makes any `prisma db push` dangerous — it wants to drop live data. Audit which tables/columns are actively used, add the active ones to schema.prisma (or document them as raw-SQL-managed), decide with the user what to do about the backup tables, and establish a safe migration workflow. Do NOT run db push --accept-data-loss.
